tagline: An ASCII-based terminal media player with a clean API, so you can drop a player into your own TUI apps.

image.alt: termflix playing a video in a terminal
image.caption: termflix running in a terminal

md:
termflix is a Python library that plays media in the terminal as ASCII art. It comes with a clean API, so developers can embed a media player in their own TUI apps.

[Add a sentence on who it is for and why you built it.]

- Install with `pip install termflix`
- Use it as a command or as a library
- Small API that fits into existing TUI apps

items.title: Clean API
items.text: A small, documented interface for adding a player to your own TUI.

items.title: Runs anywhere
items.text: Works in any terminal on Windows, Linux and macOS.
